agent.role: Nightly billing agent at Copperleaf Billing

rule.text: the same tool failing with the same error 3 or more times in 7 days is not bad luck: stop retrying, open a systematic fix

runs.recovery: waited 30 seconds and resent in batches of 50 instead of 200
retried once with a 60 second timeout
waited 30 seconds and resent in batches of 50
waited 60 seconds and resumed from message 120
waited 30 seconds and resent in batches of 50
waiting 30 seconds and resending in batches of 50 did not help; switched to batches of 20
runs.outcome: the export completed only after the switch

A.how: each night's run log goes to a conversation on the runs project; MemoryLake's extractor turns it into memory

B.how: the tool error handler writes one typed record per failure: `fact add` + `fact update --metadata` {run, date, tool, error, recovery, outcome}
